            <div class="rp-raceCourse__row ui-accordion__header
                                                                                                " data-ng-class="{ 'ui-accordion__header_active': isPaneSelected(513)}" id="513" data-ng-click="selectPane(513)" data-ng-init="                                    collapsePane(513)                                " data-test-selector="link-arrowArea">
